body:
## Symptom

`scripts/autopilot-tick.sh` has logged `tick-orphaned-prs count=1 streak=6` on six
consecutive runs (2026-08-10T00:08Z through 02:09Z), with the note "green+unarmed,
phase-7 must finish under the merge gate". Phase-7 cannot finish it, and no
number of further ticks will change that — so the counter climbs forever and the
signal is noise.

## Cause

The heuristic treats a PR as green from its **check rollup**, which reports on the
checks that exist. It never asserts that the **required** checks are among them.

PR #1487 (head `8a757b41`) carries exactly one check — `guard`, SUCCESS. The
branch ruleset (15871246) requires three, none of which are present:

    validate-author
    Fast Tests (Smoke + Unit)
    Test Suite Summary

An empty required set trivially satisfies "all required checks passed", so a PR
whose required workflows never ran at all reads as maximally green. This is the
same class as the `ci-absent-checks-read-as-green` lesson: absence and success
are indistinguishable unless presence is asserted separately.

The account-level billing lock made this visible by suppressing check creation
fleet-wide, but the defect is not caused by the lock — any path filter, workflow
syntax error, or disabled workflow produces the same false green, silently, on a
normal day.

## Why it matters beyond the noise

The tick's note tells phase-7 to *finish* these under the merge gate. A future
phase-7 that trusts the heuristic rather than re-deriving the required set could
merge a PR whose test suite never ran, on the grounds that it was flagged as
green and unarmed. The merge gate's condition (a) — "every required CI check is
green on the PR's current head" — is correct as written; the heuristic feeding it
is what's wrong.

## Fix

Compare against the ruleset's required contexts rather than the rollup alone:

1. Read required contexts from
   `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets/{id}` -> `rules[].parameters.required_status_checks[].context`
   (do not hardcode the list — it drifts, and a pinned constant cannot detect its
   own staleness).
2. A PR is green only when **every** required context is present AND
   `status == "COMPLETED"` AND `conclusion == "SUCCESS"`.
3. Missing required contexts should classify as `blocked`, distinct from `red`,
   so a suppressed-CI condition is never reported as mergeable work.

Gate on `.status != "COMPLETED"` rather than on `.conclusion`, which is `""`
rather than null while a run is in flight.
title: The orphaned-PR heuristic counts rollup state, not required-check presence, so it reports PRs that can never merge
